description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter application for a Kindle clone front-end. It includes the main application widget with bottom navigation and simple page components for Library, Downloads, and Settings tabs. The file also contains the application entry point.

classes.name: KindleCloneApp
classes.description: Main StatefulWidget representing the application's core with bottom navigation.

classes.name: _KindleCloneAppState
classes.description: State class managing the current tab index and building the Scaffold layout.

classes.name: _SimplePage
classes.description: StatelessWidget representing individual pages in the bottom navigation with a title and icon.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for KindleCloneApp.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the main application's Scaffold, including AppBar, body, and BottomNavigationBar.

methods.name: _SimplePage
methods.description: Constructor for the _SimplePage widget, requiring title and icon.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget layout for each simple page, displaying an icon and label.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entrypoint that runs the app with MaterialApp wrapping the KindleCloneApp.
